children: The Board of UIL Limited (the "Company") announces that on 2 September 2026 the Company purchased in the market 9,000 2026 ZDP Shares issued by its subsidiary, UIL Finance Limited, at a price of 150.50p per 2026 ZDP Share. The 2026 ZDP Shares, which are redeemable on 31 October 2026, will be held as an investment.
Following this purchase, UIL Limited has a holding of 5,761,075 2026 ZDP Shares and the total number of 2026 ZDP Shares in issue remains unchanged at 25,000,000.
